findings.title: Same NPE remains in the paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: The PR adds a null check to `getSubGroupsCount()` for the case where the group was deleted concurrently and `modelSupplier.get()` returns null. The three paginated `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads (lines 256, 262, 268) still dereference `modelSupplier.get()` without any check. They hit the same race, for example when a group is deleted while the admin console lists subgroups, and still throw a NullPointerException. The fix is therefore incomplete. These overloads should handle a null model the same way, for example by returning `Stream.empty()`.

findings.title: Test asserts before the reader thread finishes, so failures can be missed
findings.body: The reader thread is started but never joined. Right after the deletes, `deletedAll` is set and `caughtExceptions` is asserted to be empty immediately. A request still in flight in the reader thread may fail and add its exception after the assertion has already passed. Exceptions are also only recorded if the thread happened to run during the deletes. The regression test can therefore pass even when the bug is present. The test should keep a reference to the thread and `join()` it (with a timeout) before asserting. Ideally it should also confirm that at least one read actually ran concurrently with the deletes.
